The bootstrap interval on the classification cutoff

Source: R/evaluation_boot.R
threshold_interval.Rd

Pulled out of the bounds table because it is not a metric and does not belong in evals.csv, but it is the number to check before binarising a projection: a cutoff that moves from 0.05 to 0.20 across resamples makes a very different map at each end.

Usage

threshold_interval(bounds)

Arguments

bounds

the result of bootstrap_evaluation()

Value

c(lower, upper), or NULL when the bootstrap did not run
